ko: [Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]아무래도 샬렘 씨는 짚이는 데가 있나 보네요.
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]잘됐네요. 사람을 제대로 찾았군요, 아이리스 씨.
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]런디니움 사람들은 이런 진한 빨간색을 별로 좋아하지 않던데……
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]이 색깔은, 설마 크림슨…… 이었던가, 그건가요?
en: [Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]It seems you know what this is, Shalem.
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]That's fantastic. You went to the right person after all, Iris.
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]I'm sorry, allow me a moment to think.
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]Fine. I'm not in a rush.
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]It's a voucher for a Londinium patisserie, madams.
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]I don't have any reason to—
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]Londiniers aren't too keen on deep reds like this...
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]Well, now? Is the color that significant?
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=1)]My, Shalem, the blood's drained from your face.
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]Let's look at this shade again, shall we? Is this the Crimson—what was it?
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_106_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]おや、その半券……
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]あら、シャレムさんには心当たりがありまして？
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]よかったですね、アイリスさん。知ってる人が見つかって。
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]申し訳ありません、今思い出しますので。
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]いいんですのよ、ゆっくり思い出して頂ければ。
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)](静かにお茶を啜る)
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]あぁ、思い出しました。
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]これは——
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]これは？
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)](尻尾フリフリ)
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]ロンディニウムにあるケーキ屋の割引券ですね。
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]……あなた……
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]ウソをつきましたわね？
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]まさか、ウソをつく理由なんて——
[Dialog(head="char_208_melan", delay=0.5)]この深紅色、あまりロンディニウム人の好みじゃないですね……
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]へぇ？色と関係がありますの？
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=1.5)]うん……
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=1)]あら、顔色が変わりましてよ、シャレムさん。
[Dialog(head="char_338_iris", delay=0.5)]この色合いを見るに、おそらくは——クリムゾン……その後に続く名前はなんだったかしら？
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]フッ……
[Dialog(head="char_4025_aprot2", delay=0.5)]ご明察です、ミス・アイリス。
